members.name: status
members.doc: What the assistant is doing. Leave unset to play through every state on a loop (the docs demo).

members.name: size
members.doc: Width and height in px, 24 (inline) to 160 (empty state). Below 56 a compact drawing takes over. Default: 96.

members.name: tone
members.doc: Body color from the theme: accent with accent-foreground eyes, foreground ink with background eyes, or a muted surface with a 1px border and foreground eyes.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color for the body. Overrides tone; the eyes become a dark mix of it unless eyeColor is set.

members.name: eyeColor
members.doc: Any CSS color for the eyes and brows.

members.name: followPointer
members.doc: Eyes follow the pointer while it is over the mascot (true), anywhere on the page ("page", good for empty states) or never (false). Touch is ignored.

members.name: companion
members.doc: Show the companion dot that floats, pulses, orbits, writes and becomes the done sparkle. Default: true.

members.name: ground
members.doc: The soft contact shadow and the writing line under the mascot. Drawn only at 56px and up. Default: true.

members.name: paused
members.doc: Freeze on the current frame. The mascot also pauses by itself off screen and in background tabs, and resumes without a jump.

members.name: name
members.doc: Used in the accessible label, for example "Atlas, thinking". Default: "Assistant".

members.name: announce
members.doc: Announce status changes in a polite live region. Turn it on for the one mascot that carries status, not for decorative copies.

members.name: onStatusChange
members.doc: Called when the self-playing loop (status unset) moves to the next state.
